selectionPolicy: Keep the FIRST generation of every image. Record observations without automatic corrections. The user requests specific edits after reviewing the completed batch.
eligibility: User-approved emblematic narrative figures from the DOFUS/Krosmoz universe. Being a dungeon boss or playable class alone is not sufficient.
variables: verified identity, species and usual outfit
official game-client or documented Ankama cross-media references
portrait: One square head-and-upper-torso portrait at the established collection scale. Preserve recognizable identity, correct species anatomy and costume. Approved Forge linework and watercolor only; no copied class identity, labels, borders, logos or UI. Native PNG retained; 512x512 WebP export.
banner: One opaque 3:1 character-related environment. Anchor the scenery in verified architecture, props, visual motifs or story. Document original thematic compositions honestly. Landmark in central 60 percent; quiet lower-left for avatar. No living figures, text, baked-in avatar or UI. Native PNG retained; 1920x640 WebP export.
anatomyReviewChecklist: Trace exactly two continuous arms from one pair of shoulders to two wrists and hands; overlapping forearms must not imply extra limbs.

Inspect shoulder/back skin strips and every sleeve cuff: a narrow extra limb behind a shoulder or a second cuff can suggest a third arm even when the hands are correct. For a user-marked defect, inspect and correct that exact region while retaining their selected reference and gesture.
Check handedness and thumb position. Human hands have four fingers plus one thumb; make all five digits readable when the pose exposes the whole hand.

Inspect each finger root and natural gripping contact, especially behind props: never add a detached, superimposed or excessively hooked thumb to force a five-digit count. Keep animal hands furry with their real claws and game species. Respect naturally occluded digits.
Check one coherent clothed ribcage and torso, with no duplicate shoulder, torso or chest-shaped folds.
Inspect the large artwork and the small circular crop separately. Preserve the real selected game head and usual outfit while correcting anatomy.
For edits, keep the original generation prompt and immutable source PNG, save the exact edit prompt and reference roles/hashes, then update both native PNG and WebP.

When digit count is ambiguous, inspect an enlarged hand crop and trace each finger root. Do not infer a missing finger from a crease. In a fully exposed grip, distinguish four fingers and one thumb; record uncertainty for user review. Keep the first generation unless the user requests a specific correction.
review: Inspect each native image separately, portrait circles at 150/48px, ambiguous hands enlarged, banner desktop/mobile crops. Record issues and retain the first generation; no automatic rerender or reframing.
extensionWorkflow: Add approved character/form and a related scenario to README tracking; verify identity; save exact prompt and reference hashes before generating once; inspect; preserve masters/WebP/history and update manifest; leave unlock assignment to integration.
